correctness.rationale: A general operator has uniquely determined scalar and radical blocks; the RB identity forces scalar blocks zero and is equivalent to T²=0 and 2Tv=0. Image–kernel–isomorphism counting and the canonical k[t]/t²-module decomposition prove exact cardinalities and orbits. A direct exhaustive independent multiplication checker verifies q=2 with m=2,3 and q=3 with m=2; tests are not substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: Full available text of Farooq (arXiv:2605.15670v1) has same algebra but explicitly assumes characteristic zero, obtains R²=0 and does not count finite-field orbits. Index-three examples in characteristic two show its conclusion cannot carry over. Guo–Rosenkranz–Zheng (arXiv:1407.5306) focuses on untruncated characteristic-zero polynomial Rota–Baxter operators. No inspected primary result implies all characteristic-two assertions; unidentified more general results remain a priority risk.

value.rationale: The truncated first infinitesimal neighborhood k⊕V is a natural deformation-theoretic local algebra. Its weight-zero Rota–Baxter classification has a sharp and genuinely structural characteristic-two exception to the closest characteristic-zero theorem, determines exact finite-field nilpotence-index counts for all embedding dimensions, and provides a complete field-independent automorphism-conjugacy census.
